data.title: SREBP activity is regulated by mTORC1 and contributes to Akt-dependent cell growth
data.authors: Porstmann T; Santos CR; Griffiths B; Cully M; Wu M; Leevers S; Griffiths JR; Chung YL; Schulze A

evidence.label: Molecular — cells, biochemistry, structure
evidence.note: this describes the kind of study, not its quality

data.finding: mTORC1 activates SREBP to drive lipogenesis supporting Akt-dependent cell growth.
data.abstract_excerpt: Cell growth (accumulation of mass) needs to be coordinated with metabolic processes that are required for the synthesis of macromolecules. The PI3-kinase/Akt signaling pathway induces cell growth via activation of complex 1 of the target of rapamycin (TORC1). Here we show that Akt-dependent lipogenesis requires mTORC1 activity. Furthermore, nuclear accumulation of the mature form of the sterol responsive element binding protein (SREBP1) and expression of SREBP target genes was blocked by the mTORC1 inhibitor rapamycin.
